title: Central Texas Home Sellers Should Fix These 4 Things & Skip Everything Else
description:

Before you spend a dollar getting your home ready to sell, find out where your money actually returns. Take the free Pre-Sale Profit Map: https://realestatesteph.co/pre-sale-profit-map/
The biggest money mistake home sellers in Central Texas make isn't under-preparing the house. It's expecting a buyer to pay them back, dollar for dollar, for renovations they made for their own comfort — the custom kitchen, the gutted bathroom. Buyers don't reimburse your receipts. They pay top dollar for move-in ready.
This video covers what actually moves buyers in the Killeen, Fort Hood, Georgetown, and Pflugerville markets: curb appeal and front-yard landscaping, finished outdoor living space and backyard privacy, fresh paint and trim (including the cosmetic cracks Texas foundations create), and the single biggest knob-turner — flooring. Plus the simple framework for deciding what's worth doing and what to skip entirely.
The rule that drives it all: buyers paying top dollar want move-in ready. Buyers who want a project want it cheap. You can't charge for both.
